title: hlx preview db-url — CLI Implementation
description: Walkthrough of the new preview command group and db-url subcommand in helix-cli

steps.title: Import preview router
steps.description: The runPreview function is imported from the new preview command group module, following the same pattern as runTickets, runComments, etc.

steps.title: Usage text registration
steps.description: The preview db-url command is listed in the top-level help text, between comments and library entries.

steps.title: Switch case dispatch
steps.description: The 'preview' case uses configOrHelp(args.slice(1)) to allow --help without auth, then delegates to runPreview. This matches the pattern of all other command groups.

steps.title: Preview command group router
steps.description: runPreview parses the subcommand from args[0], handles --help at the group level, and dispatches to the db-url handler. Uses extractTicketRef + resolveTicket for ticket resolution.

steps.title: Ticket resolution pipeline
steps.description: extractTicketRef(rest) extracts the raw ticket ref, then resolveTicket(config, rawRef) resolves it to {id, shortId} — exactly the same as hlx tickets get. The resolved internal ID is passed to the handler.

steps.title: db-url handler
steps.description: cmdPreviewDbUrl calls hxFetch to the server endpoint, extracts connectionUri from the JSON response, writes it to stdout with process.stdout.write, and writes the hint to stderr with process.stderr.write. No try/catch needed — errors propagate to the top-level catch.
